scientific_integrity: Exact formulas proved by finite-extension classification and a disjoint-event count; uniform asymptotic justified algebraically. Independent finite enumeration is corroborating evidence, not a substitute for the proof. Closest literature on general Henson extensions and one-type counts is acknowledged; no invented provenance or scientific certification.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to ordered pairs outside individually named complete multipartite graphs with at least four nonempty parts in the homogeneous forbidden-(r+1)-clique graph. Fractions weight complete types equally, not ambient vertices. The fixed-r asymptotic requires every part size to diverge. Full independent review and priority verification have not been performed.
title: A collision law for two-types over maximal multipartite parameter graphs in Henson structures
